input.rationale: Sections 9.1 and 9.2 impose substantively identical caps on IBM and on Customer (greater of $100,000 or 12 months' charges paid), and Section 10 contains a mutual consequential-damages exclusion, so mutuality, the fee basis and the damages exclusion meet the playbook (the $100,000 floor rather than USD 1,000,000, and "paid" rather than "paid or payable", are minor shortfalls of the preferred position only). The clause nevertheless fails the fallback on carve-outs: only indemnification payments (9.1(a)/9.2(a)) and bodily-injury/tangible property damage sit outside the cap, with no carve-out for breach of confidentiality, gross negligence or willful misconduct — and Section 6 expressly makes Sections 5, 9 and 10 prevail over the AECI for confidential information in the hosting environment, while 9.1(c)(2) excludes all liability for loss of or damage to Customer's records or data. We therefore added a single mutual Excluded Claims sentence placing confidentiality/data protection and security breaches, indemnities, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement outside the Section 9 limits.

proposal.summary: Add mutual uncapped carve-out (Excluded Claims) for confidentiality/data protection, indemnities, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a short mutual carve-out so that confidentiality, data protection and security breaches, indemnities, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other party's IP sit outside the Section 9 limits and the data/records exclusion; our playbook requires these Excluded Claims to be uncapped. The mutual caps and the Section 10 consequential-damages exclusion are otherwise acceptable to us.

ops.text: 9.3 Excluded Claims. Notwithstanding Sections 9.1 and 9.2 (including Subsection 9.1(c)(2)), the limitations and exclusions of liability in this Section 9 do not apply to Excluded Claims, and each party remains fully liable for its Excluded Claims. "Excluded Claims" means a party's indemnification obligations under Section 8, a party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, a party's gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and a party's infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights.
